_comment: Replay budget for one heavy player's day (#3398, part 1 of #3294, epic #3273). Test: frontend/src/game/_shared/__tests__/replay.budget.test.ts. Each metric has a 'max' (what CI enforces) and a '_measured' (what the test measured when the budget was set; documentation only). max = measured + ~15% headroom (0 stays 0). Raising any max is an owner decision tied to revenue (CLAUDE.md: cost, then performance, then data): edit this file in a reviewed PR. See docs/PERFORMANCE.md, 'Replay budget'.
_day: 29 games (3 Hearts, 5 Yacht vs CPU, 5 Solitaire, 3 Star Swarm, 10 x 2048, Daily Word, Sudoku, Mahjong), a trip to the background in 3 of them, and an hour with the API down.

day._httpRequests: Every request the day sends to the API, failed ones included (POST /games, POST /games/:id/events, PATCH /games/:id/complete).
day._uploadedBytes: JSON bytes of every request body, failed ones included.
day._requestsDuringOfflineHour: Requests sent while the API is down: the worker's backoff (1 s doubling to 30 min) bounds them.
day._storageWrites: AsyncStorage setItem calls over the whole day, uploads' deletes included.
day._sentryEventsHealthy: captureException + captureMessage + captureFeedback outside the offline hour and the 30 min backoff tail after it. 0 on a healthy day.
day._sentryEventsRecording: The same, while the day's games are recorded (their replay paths and recorders, before the day is played). Must be 0.
day._sentryEventsOffline: The same, during the offline hour and its backoff tail: bounded, and 0 today.
day._gameplayRequestsWhileOpenInForeground: POST /games/:id/events carrying gameplay rows (not game_started, hand_resolved, game_ended) while the session is open in the foreground and its oldest held row is younger than GAMEPLAY_HOLD_MAX_MS (5 min). Must be 0.
day._holdFallbackRequests: The same upload once the oldest held row is 5 min old (the fallback, #3275): a game longer than 5 min sends its gameplay rows in the foreground, once per 5 min.

_storedBytesPerGameType: Server storage over the day, per game type: jsonb::text of each accepted event's data plus 200 B a row (backend/games/replay_caps.py), game_started and game_ended included.
_storageWritesPerGame: The most AsyncStorage writes any one game of the type cost while it was played (its saves, the pending-games counter, the lifecycle uploads and a background release inside it).
